learner_operation: Returning c/x is the intended mathematical operation, even if it looks like substitution. Fixed coefficient, correct position, or template-specific sign cues would be incidental. Sign and representation may vary while the derivative rule remains fixed. Recognize reciprocal coefficients in a quotient, then apply the constant multiple rule.
